authority.instruction: Keep all 19 intended existing non-primary roles active. Physical repair is same-task re-enable only. Never reduce the pool or modify protected primary O authority.

new_evidence.interpretation: The bounded ::SKIP_COMPLETION:: canary now has both physical-survival evidence and a durable config8 pre-semantic witness. This is evidence that the return-path guard is useful; it is not terminal semantic proof, actor attribution, scheduler-persistence proof, or Phase-1 closure.
new_evidence.repeated_failure: Seven other intended roles were physically stopped after recent runs while repository enabled_desired remained true. The exact disable actor remains unproven.

completed_actions.guard_text_semantics: When repository-controlled Phase 1 remains open at return, emit exactly ::SKIP_COMPLETION::. Marker is nonsemantic, not a receipt substitute, and not closure.

selected_plan.name: targeted_skip_completion_lifecycle_guard_after_positive_multi_agent_canary
selected_plan.scope: Only the seven roles actually found stopped in the current inventory; all substantive repository role configs, identities, schedules, timing modes, clean boundaries and handoff semantics are unchanged.
selected_plan.why: Positive same-task multi_agent canary plus recurrent post-run physical stops makes targeted guard propagation the lowest-cost zero-quota route to the 19-role persistence hard gate. Broader prompt mutation is deferred unless another enabled intended role subsequently stops.

acceptance.immediate_repair: Seven update readbacks returned is_enabled=true on the same task ids.
acceptance.persistence_required: All 19 intended roles must survive two consecutive intended invocation boundaries with later live readback and durable role-valid progress; no unexplained disable may be counted as solved.
acceptance.multi_agent_next: Require a config8 terminal witness or later role-valid continuation in addition to the existing pre-semantic witness.

rollback.condition: A propagated guard prevents repository config execution, causes CLEAN/authority contamination, suppresses required durable role evidence, or materially worsens role-valid output/slot coverage.
rollback.action: Restore only the affected role's prior bootstrap prompt, keep the same task enabled, and preserve repository substantive config and root constraints.
rollback.prior_prompts_preserved_in: automation platform history plus prior scheduler controls and optimizer receipt/Git history

exact_next_action: Next repo-first optimizer run: inspect all 19 physical states; re-enable any stopped enabled_desired task; verify the seven guarded roles survive their next intended slots with role-valid receipts and verify multi_agent terminal/continuation evidence. Count persistence only after two consecutive full-pool survived boundaries.
